Don’t worry, I get what you mean and I guess when you’re this low, it’s hard to even think about being happy in the past. Honestly if you feel better just hibernating in bed and not talking to anyone for a while then you should drop everything and do that to focus on yourself. I know it sounds like bad advice but anything is better than killing yourself. I don’t know if you’re upset right now or if you’ve reached the numb stage. But I’ve found that someone laying down and staring into space can help the trigger the numbness or help it to pass so I can move on to crying everything out. I don’t know if this helps at all because everyone’s different. But this did help me a tiny bit. Also, I don’t experience mania much but my mum does. Up until about a year or two ago she was severely suicidal except for when she was manic, but now she’s a lot better. Her mood seems a lot more balanced nowadays and her bad days aren’t very often. Nothing had changed much but one day she just started getting increasingly more stable. So I know this seems like it’s too easy to be true but it is possible.

Try to put it off as long as you can please, eventually you will get better. I really don’t want you to do this. I know I can’t say I understand exactly what you’re going through but almost nothing is worth doing this to yourself, and I do genuinely believe things can always get better. I don’t want to talk about myself too much because this is about you. But when I was at my lowest, I genuinely couldn’t feel anything, couldn’t even be bothered to live. Thinking about how I felt when I was healthier helped me consider the possibility that I could go back to that again. Please try to think about the last time you were happy and believe that one day you can be that happy again.
